remarks: Welcome to 13722 Grider Avenue, a beautifully reimagined residence tucked away on a peaceful cul-de-sac in the highly sought-after Hollyglen neighborhood. Thoughtfully renovated with an emphasis on timeless design, quality craftsmanship, and effortless indoor-outdoor living, this stunning 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom home blends warmth, sophistication, and modern comfort. From the moment you arrive, the home's fresh exterior, new dual-pane windows, beautiful landscaping, and inviting walkway create a lasting first impression.
